verses.text: Paul, an apostle (not [sent] from men nor through the agency of man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead),
verses.textZh: 作使徒的保羅（不是由於人，也不是藉著人，乃是藉著耶穌基督，與叫他從死裡復活的父神）

verses.text: and all the brethren who are with me, To the churches of Galatia:
verses.textZh: 和一切與我同在的眾弟兄，寫信給加拉太的各教會。

verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textZh: 願恩惠、平安從父神與我們的主耶穌基督歸與你們！

verses.text: who gave Himself for our sins so that He might rescue us from this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
verses.textZh: 基督照我們父神的旨意，為我們的罪捨己，要救我們脫離這罪惡的世代。

verses.text: to whom [be] the glory forevermore. Amen.
verses.textZh: 但願榮耀歸於神，直到永永遠遠。阿們！

verses.text: I am amazed that you are so quickly deserting Him who called you by the grace of Christ, for a different gospel;
verses.textZh: 我希奇你們這麼快離開那藉著基督之恩召你們的，去從別的福音。

verses.text: which is [really] not another; only there are some who are disturbing you and want to distort the gospel of Christ.
verses.textZh: 那並不是福音，不過有些人攪擾你們，要把基督的福音更改了。

verses.text: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you a gospel contrary to what we have preached to you, he is to be accursed!
verses.textZh: 但無論是我們，是天上來的使者，若傳福音給你們，與我們所傳給你們的不同，他就應當被咒詛。

verses.text: As we have said before, so I say again now, if any man is preaching to you a gospel contrary to what you received, he is to be accursed!
verses.textZh: 我們已經說了，現在又說，若有人傳福音給你們，與你們所領受的不同，他就應當被咒詛。

verses.text: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a bond-servant of Christ.
verses.textZh: 我現在是要得人的心呢？還是要得神的心呢？我豈是討人的喜歡麼？若仍舊討人的喜歡，我就不是基督的僕人了。

verses.text: For I would have you know, brethren, that the gospel which was preached by me is not according to man.
verses.textZh: 弟兄們，我告訴你們，我素來所傳的福音不是出於人的意思。

verses.text: For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught it, but [I received it] through a revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.textZh: 因為我不是從人領受的，也不是人教導我的，乃是從耶穌基督啟示來的。

verses.text: For you have heard of my former manner of life in Judaism, how I used to persecute the church of God beyond measure and tried to destroy it;
verses.textZh: 你們聽見我從前在猶太教中所行的事，怎樣極力逼迫殘害神的教會。

verses.text: and I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries among my countrymen, being more extremely zealous for my ancestral traditions.
verses.textZh: 我又在猶太教中，比我本國許多同歲的人更有長進，為我祖宗的遺傳更加熱心。

verses.text: But when God, who had set me apart [even] from my mother's womb and called me through His grace, was pleased
verses.textZh: 然而，那把我從母腹裡分別出來、又施恩召我的神，

verses.text: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately consult with flesh and blood,
verses.textZh: 既然樂意將他兒子啟示在我心裡，叫我把他傳在外邦人中，我就沒有與屬血氣的人商量，

verses.text: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me; but I went away to Arabia, and returned once more to Damascus.
verses.textZh: 也沒有上耶路撒冷去見那些比我先作使徒的，惟獨往亞拉伯去，後又回到大馬色。

verses.text: Then three years later I went up to Jerusalem to become acquainted with Cephas, and stayed with him fifteen days.
verses.textZh: 過了三年，才上耶路撒冷去見磯法，和他同住了十五天。

verses.text: But I did not see any other of the apostles except James, the Lord's brother.
verses.textZh: 至於別的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都沒有看見。

verses.text: (Now in what I am writing to you, I assure you before God that I am not lying.)
verses.textZh: 我寫給你們的不是謊話，這是我在神面前說的。

verses.text: Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.textZh: 以後我到了敘利亞和基利家境內。

verses.text: I was [still] unknown by sight to the churches of Judea which were in Christ;
verses.textZh: 那時，猶太信基督的各教會都沒有見過我的面。

verses.text: but only, they kept hearing, 'He who once persecuted us is now preaching the faith which he once tried to destroy.'
verses.textZh: 不過聽說那從前逼迫我們的，現在傳揚他原先所殘害的真道。

verses.text: And they were glorifying God because of me.
verses.textZh: 他們就為我的緣故，歸榮耀給神。
